Thanks again for the call last week. As we discussed, the GCP co-sell page will include a short customer quote (1–2 sentences), Nymble's logo, and a one-paragraph case blurb that highlights the integration points (Redwood hosted inference + Nymble data pipeline).

Would it be possible to get: 
- A 1–2 sentence quote we can publish (attribution: Lisa Park, Head of Product)
- The preferred logo file (EPS or SVG) and any usage guidance

Thanks — appreciate your help here.

Karthik
